title: Growth plates are the zones where bones lengthen as a child grows
summary: NIAMS says bones lengthen at growth plates, special zones that grow as a child grows taller.
body: The NIAMS bones lesson says that as you get older and grow taller, your bones grow too. It calls the special zones that grow with you growth plates. The lesson also says bone tissue keeps changing, with old tissue broken down and new tissue made. This card is the growth-plate sentence. It does not give a height, and it does not say when the plates close, because that lesson does not print a closing age.

sources.title: Health Lesson: Learning About Bones
